purpose: After v114 rejected continuation and showed sparse/nonportable reversal from one-minute swing pools, test three objective ICT liquidity sources independently: completed Asia range, completed London range, and previous completed UTC day. Each account uses the same causal scenario: first boundary sweep and rejection only after the range is immutable; opposite displacement and CHoCH; causal FVG; FVG retest; next-minute activation; invalidation beyond sweep extreme; target at the opposite boundary of the same pre-observed range. Run all three sources on both locked BTC development weeks through NautilusTrader 1.230.0 with current-NAV risk 3%, unchanged realistic costs, and no notional cap.
